statuses.LINKED_MATCH: Raw bytes equal the complete target extent at the original RVA in a fresh unresolved-free natural link of the canonical sources under the reviewed link plan (scripts/linked.py; owner ruling 2026-10-20); separate from FUNCTION_MATCH
